overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ONDS ETF (ONDL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Ondas Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: ONDS), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. ONDL was launched on Dec 29, 2025 and is issued by Defiance.
